title: Abdul El-Sayed Responds to JD Vance's Wife Warning on Stephen A. Smith's Show
summary: On "Straight Shooter," Stephen A. said the comedian's comment “stung” because it came from someone he respects.
body_markdown:
On last night’s episode of SiriusXM’s[“Straight Shooter with Stephen A.,”](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/straight-shooter-with-stephen-a) Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed responded to Vice President JD Vance’s recent warning to keep his wife’s name out of his mouth.


[Abdul El-Sayed Straight Shooter with Stephen A. Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-StraightShooter)


Asked by Stephen A. Smith whether he planned to get into a fight with the vice president, El-Sayed said no — before accusing Vance of hypocrisy.


“If you don’t wanna talk about my wife, maybe you should talk to your boss about how he brought spouses into it,” El-Sayed said.


El-Sayed was referring to President Donald Trump previously posting a photo featuring both men and their wives.


The Senate nominee also criticized Vance over the Trump administration’s policies, arguing that the vice president “knows better.”


“I just think it’s kind of important to pay attention to hypocrisy, which is something JD Vance doesn’t wanna talk about,” El-Sayed said.

### Straight Shooter with Stephen A.


Smith’s live politics and culture program, “Straight Shooter with Stephen A.,” airs live at 6pm ET every Wednesday. “Straight Shooter” welcomes notable figures from the worlds of politics, entertainment, business, and beyond, while offering Smith’s trademark no-nonsense commentary on the day’s most pressing headlines. The show also gives listeners the chance to join the conversation, with Smith taking live calls from across the country.


“I’ve spent my career speaking my mind, asking tough questions, and zeroing in on the issues that matter most,” said Smith. “Whether it’s my new sports show on Mad Dog Sports Radio or talking politics on POTUS, I’m here to challenge, entertain, and engage SiriusXM listeners.”
